name: dependency-run-by-git-hook
description: A file below .husky or .githooks is read as a workflow step's run command is, and so are the run commands of a lefthook file and the entry commands of .pre-commit-config.yaml, so a dependency whose command a git hook runs is needed. The whole text of each of these files is held, so a dependency only a hook's comment names is used as well, and one no hook, script or workflow names is reported.
